crossRefs.note: Jesus said to them, “Can the friends of the bridegroom mourn, as long as the bridegroom is with them? But the days will…
When an unclean spirit has gone out of a man, he passes through waterless places, seeking rest, and doesn’t find it.
He spoke to them many things in parables, saying, “Behold, a farmer went out to sow.
“For the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who was the master of a household, who went out early in the morning to hire…
But what do you think? A man had two sons, and he came to the first, and said, ‘Son, go work today in my vineyard.’
With many such parables he spoke the word to them, as they were able to hear it.
Without a parable he didn’t speak to them; but privately to his own disciples he explained everything.
He said, “To you it is given to know the mysteries of God’s Kingdom, but to the rest in parables; that ‘seeing they may…
But he said to him, “A certain man made a great supper, and he invited many people.
